title: Deep Time
hook: Tyrannosaurus rex lived closer to you
script: Tyrannosaurus rex lived closer to you They were separated by 89 million years Stegosaurus vanished about 150 million years ago The dinosaurs we imagine fighting side by side were often separated by more time than separates us from the last dinosaurs If the 4.5 billion year history of the Earth were condensed into a single 24-hour day Stegosaurus would have roamed the Earth around 10:30 PM, while humans wouldn't appear until 11:59:59 PM You are closer in time to a T. rex than a Stegosaurus is

scenes.voiceover: Tyrannosaurus rex lived closer to you
They were separated by 89 million years
Stegosaurus vanished about 150 million years ago
The dinosaurs we imagine fighting side by side were often separated by more time than separates us from the last dinosaurs
If the 4.5 billion year history of the Earth were condensed into a single 24-hour day
Stegosaurus would have roamed the Earth around 10:30 PM, while humans wouldn't appear until 11:59:59 PM
You are closer in time to a T. rex than a Stegosaurus is

captions: What's the most mind-blowing dinosaur fact? Did you know this?
Dinosaurs are not just ancient, they're deeply separated in time
The Earth's history is almost too vast to comprehend
